evidence_quotes: Fosfaatrechten. Knelgevallenregeling. Ter bepaling van de forfaitaire productie van dierlijke meststoffen is de totale melkproductie, van in dit geval 2013, van belang.
rationale: This Dutch CBb decision concerns agricultural phosphate quotas (fosfaatrechten) and the hardship clause (knelgevallenregeling) based on 2013 dairy milk and animal manure production under the Meststoffenwet, which is explicitly excluded from water law/governance under the protocol.
